name: GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Minions Edition
description: The GAN 356 ME 3x3 (Magnetic) - Minions Edition brings Illumination's Minions to one of GAN's most tunable speed cubes, wrapping a fully adjustable magnetic 3x3 in a denim-blue inner shell, theme-colored magnetic capsules, and a Minions center cap. It's a performance cube first and a collector's piece second — playable out of the box, dialed in exactly how you want it.
features: GES Pro+: Swap between 12 gears to define your handfeel — adjust the feel by hand until the cube matches how you turn.
Turbo Magnetic Capsules: Enhanced magnets for instant, positive snapping into each layer.
Theme-colored capsules: The magnetic capsules carry the Minions blue theme, so the tuning hardware doubles as part of the look.
Wing-shaped Core 2.0: A redesigned core built to lift turning speed and add stability during fast solves.
Honeycomb contact surface & tracks: Textured pieces lock lube in place for long-lasting, silky-smooth turning between applications.
Denim blue inner shell: A vibrant themed interior that carries the Minions look all the way through the mechanism.
